description: Golden vector for the 1/N-octave band aggregation (shared C core / Kotlin fallback). 32 FFT bins linearly spaced 0-16000 Hz (500 Hz apart); dB magnitude ramp of 1 dB per bin (bin i = -75 + i dB); noise floor -60 dB; 10 bands of 1/6 octave (ratio 2^(1/6) since bandCount <= 40). A band averages the bins whose frequency lies in [center/ratio, center*ratio] and whose magnitude is strictly above the floor; a band with no qualifying bin takes the floor. Bins 0-14 sit at or below the floor (gating exercised inside the 8000 Hz band, which contains one gated-out bin at exactly -60). Keep this file in sync with dsp/golden_bands.json (the C-side test lives in dsp/).
